start: Talk to the Carnillean guard in Ardougne (2570, 3276).

quests: Making Friends with My Arm (upstream PR; explicit external flag until integration)
prerequisites.consumables: 100 coins for the Khazard Barman; optional 20 coins for a standard lockpick from Martin Thwait.
prerequisites.equipment: Standard lockpick is mandatory at the Carnillean chest (Strange Old Lockpick is not compatible); tinderbox may be recovered in Weiss dungeon; anti-poison, food, prayer, and combat loadout are advised.

stage_flow: Carnillean guard; inspect upstairs evidence; bribe Khazard Barman with 100 coins.
Follow six landmarks through Fight Arena/Ardougne and fight level-148 Evelot.
Travel through Hazeel cave by raft, speak with Hazeel; return to guard, Claus and the secret Carnillean chest. Use ordinary lockpick, return dusty scroll to Hazeel.
Approach Weiss through the existing Trollheim graph; speak with Big Fish, Snowflake and Big Fish, then enter the cave.
Fight level-262 Khazard assassin; find Hazeel and examine barrel, crate, note and letter.
Central word gate BLOOD; northern chest 7402; tinderbox from crate; braziers north-west, south-east, north-east, south-west.
Open western jewel chest; north direction gate LEFT-UP-LEFT-DOWN; use lever handle, pull lever, acquire second jewel shard.
Combine shards; use jewel to obtain icy chest key; open southern gate and enter crevice.
Defeat quest level-368 Phantom Muspah (Strange Creature); return for Weiss revelation; Hazeel teleports to Ardougne; report to guard.

unlocks.after_big_fish: Weiss dungeon cave entry; no earlier shortcut into the dungeon.
on_completion: Ancient essence mining in Ghorrock Dungeon

combat.evelot: Level 148; outcome must be explicitly successful, no assumed fixed combat XP.
combat.assassin: Level 262; smoke-bomb/special mechanics; planned success, no guaranteed victory.
combat.muspah: Quest level 368 Strange Creature. Handle overhead prayers, prayer-draining attacks, defensive shield and different weapon styles; success-dependent planned outcome.

supplies_and_transport.lockpick_shop: Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den sells standard lockpicks for 20 coins; modeled with 50 Agility and 50 Thieving route (not the alternative 99 Thieving only access). Shop supplies the missing item rather than seeding it.
supplies_and_transport.tinderbox: A free tinderbox is found in the Weiss dungeon crate before the four braziers.
supplies_and_transport.walking: The branch already connects Ardougne to the Troll Child waypoint via overland graph; added a long northward walk to Weiss rather than teleporting. Exact Weiss travel time estimated.
supplies_and_transport.caves: Both directions of Hazeel raft and Weiss cave, puzzle chambers, and Muspah crevice represented, including locked gate requirements.

remaining_review_gaps: Making Friends with My Arm is marked Added in tracker #20 but its completion producer is only on a concurrent PR. The draft external flag flag.secrets.making_friends_external must be replaced or linked when those branches integrate.
Exact Quest Helper co-ordinates and interior distances may be affected by instance/layout shifts; local walking times and several access points are estimates.

The path from Troll Child to Weiss is abstracted as a long walk. It assumes the Making Friends with My Arm route to Weiss is genuinely unlocked; later integration should attach its gate to the shared travel edge.
The quest's in-world cutscene return from Weiss to Ardougne is modeled by the revelation action changing end_location_id, with no independent teleport spell cost.
The planner cannot price a complete combat loadout, prayer, potion, food, death, or incidental combat XP; each fight requires a planned successful outcome.
Whether the ordinary lockpick can break on the Carnillean chest and whether puzzle notes remain in the inventory after completion should be verified in-game.
The quest guide's gate solutions are fixed for this route; no generalized lock or matching puzzle solver exists.
Rogues' Den alternate access by 99 Thieving, other lockpick sources and a reusable shop stock model are deferred; the one-time shop action is sufficient for this quest replay.
Quest-specific items are assumed consumed at the lever, jewel assembly and icy chest; exact item cleanup after completion requires a live check.
